description: An almost disjoint family of infinite subsets of the naturals maps injectively to distinct nonzero finite-error classes with pairwise zero meets.
signature:
Lemmatheca.SetTheory.SubsetsModuloSmallSets.almostDisjoint_classes (A : Set (Set ℕ))
  (hA : Lemmatheca.SetTheory.AlmostDisjoint.IsAlmostDisjoint A) :
  Set.InjOn (Lemmatheca.SetTheory.SubsetsModuloSmallSets.mk (Lemmatheca.SetTheory.SubsetsModuloSmallSets.finiteIdeal ℕ))
      A ∧
    (∀
        q ∈
          Lemmatheca.SetTheory.SubsetsModuloSmallSets.mk (Lemmatheca.SetTheory.SubsetsModuloSmallSets.finiteIdeal ℕ) ''
            A,
        q ≠ ⊥) ∧
      (Lemmatheca.SetTheory.SubsetsModuloSmallSets.mk (Lemmatheca.SetTheory.SubsetsModuloSmallSets.finiteIdeal ℕ) ''
            A).Pairwise
        fun q r => q ⊓ r = ⊥
